title: census.py read accepts a date that is no calendar day and an empty note
goal: census.py read refuses, exit 2 before any write, a --date that is no valid YYYY-MM-DD day (2026-13-45) and an empty --note

run:
import subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/census.py", "--root", "public", "read", "S100", "--note", "n", "--date", "2026-13-45", "--dry-run"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("exit", r.returncode, r.stdout[-150:])
sys.exit(1 if r.returncode == 0 else 0)
